chunks: And Sama'ah narrated from Abū Baṣīr, who said: I heard Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام say:

A man came to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and said: O Messenger of Allah, I have performed ẓihār against my wife. He said: Go and free a slave. He said: I do not have one. He said: Go and fast two consecutive months. He said: I am not able. He said: Go and feed sixty needy persons. He said: I do not have the means. So the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: I will give charity on your behalf.

He said: So he gave him dates to feed sixty needy persons, then said: Go and give it as charity. The man said: By the One who sent you with the truth as a Prophet, I do not know anyone between its two lava tracts who is more in need of it than me and my dependants. He said: Then go, eat, and feed your dependants.

key_terms.أَتَصَدَّقُ عَنْكَ: I will give charity on your behalf
key_terms.تَمْرًا: dates given for distribution as food
key_terms.رَقَبَةً: a slave to be freed as expiation
key_terms.سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًا: sixty needy persons to be fed
key_terms.ظَاهَرْتُ: I performed ẓihār, declaring one’s wife unlawful in the pre-Islamic formula

ai.seo_question: What is the kaffarah for ẓihār if a person cannot afford or perform the required expiation?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the expiation for ẓihār in a graded sequence: freeing a slave, then fasting two consecutive months, then feeding sixty needy persons. It also shows the mercy of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم toward a man who was unable to fulfill the expiation from his own means, allowing the provided food to be used for his needy family.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.4837 - Sama'ah narrated from Abu Basir, who said:
I heard Abu Abdullah (as) say:

"A man came to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and said: 'O Messenger of Allah (swt), I have performed ẓihar (declared my wife as unlawful to me).'
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Go and free a slave.'
The man replied: 'I do not have one.'
The Prophet (sw) said: 'Then go and fast for two consecutive months.'
The man replied: 'I am not able to do so.'
The Prophet (sw) said: 'Then go and feed sixty poor people.'
The man replied: 'I do not have the means.'
The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) then said: 'I will give charity on your behalf.'"

He (peace be upon him and his family) gave him dates to feed sixty poor people and said:
"Go and give this in charity."
The man said: "By the One who sent you with the truth as a Prophet (sw), I do not know anyone between these two mountains (of Madinah) who is more in need of this than me and my family."
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Then go and feed your family with it."
